text: This business is a scam. Beware. This location is paid parking and has rude, questionable staff. I ordered on the mobile app and did drive thru. I paid on the app. When I got to the drive thru window this guy said oh I can't find your order. He then asked if I put it in the right location. I showed him the order on my phone and he goes oh yeah thats the right location I can't find it. Okay so what do you want me to do? I paid for it so I asked for a refund and he said oh we can't get refunds. I paid for goods and services and to take money and not get goods and services is fraud. I then asked to speak to the manager and he said oh well she's going to say the same thing. Thats not what I asked. So then the manager comes over and was able to find my order, and told him not to he rude. So then they gave me half the order but 1 burger was missing and seemed lost and confused when I mentioned it. After pulling up the app only did they realize their mistake and make it. Oh and to top it off its paid parking and I got a parking ticket even though I scanned the free QR code for parking. This location also has a code for the bathroom. Very poor location and this location is almost a scam. Beware!
author: Byron

text:
Sidel should be fired!

Was the rudest person I have ever spoken to! Whenever I drove up she said “What?”

Put in my order wrong multiple times. Had to have her fix it. Whenever I pulled up to the 1st window there we 4 employees talking and no one came up to the window for atleast 2 minutes so I moved on to the second window.

She then came to the window and said “wrong window” and put her handout.

I took a picture of the sticker of the twitter handle to tweet you guys and the cashier at that window opened the window and yelled at me “excuse me why are you taking a picture of me”

At which point I just got mad! Didn’t want to deal with this.

The I’m guessing manager came with my food and asked if there was a problem while handing me my food and I replied you employees are being very rude. He said “I’m sorry what can I do for you”

I drove off very mad!

Once I looked at my order it was wrong!
author: Spencer B

text: Three times now, my boyfriend & I have tried to order from this specific McDonald’s through uber eats & have never received our order. EVERY time we had multiple different uber drivers show up to pick up the order & then leave without saying a word to us. Tonight we tried to order again with small hope. We can see this particular McDonald’s from our apartment so we are able to somewhat tell if it is busy or not. Tonight as the same with every single other time we’ve tried to order, the uber driver showed up said they were making it & then disconnected. When another driver showed up we asked for an update on what was going on & they told us to cancel the order as someone had stolen it. Do NOT order through ubereats to this location as they clearly have no idea how to properly give out orders to the delivery drivers. Such a waste of time.
author: Grace Gilders

text: Pulled up to the drive-thru,  no other vehicles were in line. Someone spoke into the mic, which initially I thought was a greeting, but it sounded like he was having a conversation with another co-worker on a hot mic, saying that he was going to take a break.  Then I heard other voices coming through the speaker. I said Hello, but nobody answered.  Instead, it sounded like 2 or 3 different voices were having a conversation on a hot mic. I waited, finally said Hello again, no response to me, just nonstop chatter amongst themselves.  I waited a couple minutes, saying Hello occasionally.  No response.  By this time other cars were pulling into line behind me. Still no response from the drive-thru, so I finally pulled up and just left, having not interacted with anyone at all. So they lost my business.
author: Tracey K Houston

text: WORST BUSINESS TO EVER OPERATE. First of all, EVERY person that works at this McDonald’s is incredibly rude. I’ve only ever ordered a drink from this place and they can’t even get that right. This first time I went I sat at the drive thru speaker for 12 minutes and no one said anything so I pulled to a window. After sitting at the window for an additional 8 minutes someone finally came to the window and took my order. I received the wrong drink and they refused to remake it. Second time I pulled up to order a drink and they said “we’re getting ready for breakfast” I said can I just order a drink and they said “NO!” yet it states online and in store that they are open 24 hours a day. Save yourself some time and energy and go someone else, Any where else!
author: Elizabeth B

text: If I ever needed a sign to stop eating fast food, this would be the one. I ordered a chicken biscuit from McDonald's at 1201 Broadway in Nashville, TN and my chicken was practically raw. My cause for concern is how I was told to take the receipt back to have the order made correctly. After explaining that I ate raw chicken and would not ever purchase chicken again, I was told they can make you something else. Ugh, I'm so disgusted. Please be careful when ordering poultry. Fast food is just that, fast. Chicken needs a bit of thought when preparing and cooking. I wish I was giving a raving review, but unfortunately, I am not. I will say that the ladies who are always working the windows, early morning, are very kind. One is a manager. I appreciate them!
author: Syreeta Butler

text: I had a mobile order. They read it back to me and they read it back incorrectly. I corrected them to what my actual order was and they got a major attitude telling me “yeah this is your order”, it wasn’t. Both of my burgers were wrong like I had expressed, the fries were the wrong size, the sauce was wrong etc. the bottom of my bag was also soaking wet. This is incredibly disappointing that after I even directly expressed that they were reading me back the wrong order they insisted they were correct, when they weren’t. Now I’m out the food, money and time that was wasted at this location. Do better and lose the attitude next time

text:
Worst McDonald’s experience I’ve ever had.
I placed my order through the kiosk and waited over an hour without receiving my food. The screen showed that my order was “now serving,” but when I asked the staff, they said the screen was inaccurate and not to trust it.

The store was dirty, disorganized, and the customer service was extremely poor. There was no clear system, and it felt chaotic from start to finish.

This was a complete waste of our time.

I've tried to get a refund but nothing. This store is absolutely terrible. WOULD NOT RECOMMEND
